title: architectural-adaptive-compiler-pipelines-for-mha-gqa-moe-with-kernel-granularity
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Scope: Implement a flexible compiler pipeline and publishable performance profiles that support kernel-selection and tuning at per-layer granularity for MHA, GQA and MoE-style models. We need a pipeline that can: 1) generate per-model/per-version compile artifacts, 2) produce signed performance profiles with canonical inputs, 3) support runtime policy that can switch kernels per layer or group of heads, and 4) safely roll out compiled profiles with canary evaluation and automated rollback. Motivation: current compile/pin mechanism operates at coarse model-level presets and struggles with hybrid architectures (GQA / MoE) where different layers benefit from different kernels and quantization. This ticket delivers the compile pipeline changes, profile publishing metadata, pinning semantics (kernel-granularity), and the release/rollback safety net.
acceptance_criteria:
- New compile pipeline produces per-layer kernel candidates and an audited performance profile JSON for a given model version (MHA/GQA/MoE).
- Profile includes deterministic canonical inputs, latency distribution, memory footprint, and a kernel confidence score.
- Runtime can select a kernel at layer granularity given a pinned profile; fallback to default reference kernel on mismatch.
- Canary rollout workflow validates perf/stability on 1–5% traffic and automatically rolls back on regression thresholds.
- Documentation (console + API) for publishing and pinning kernel-granularity profiles exists.
- End-to-end test coverage for profile verification, publish, pin, and rollback flows.
